description: The hidden completion entry point a shell script calls: `<program> __complete <words...> <to-complete>` (or `__completeNoDesc`, which drops descriptions). Each case runs `args` against the `tree` and pins stdout: one completion per line (value, then a tab and the description when there is one), then the directive line `:<n>` (0 default, 1 error, 4 no file completion, 8 filter by extension, 16 directories only). `tree` is a kit root named `program` with `commands` (each with `about`, `flags` and optional child `commands`), root `aliases` (alias name to target command path), `flag_enums` (an empty `path` is tree-wide), `flag_completers` and `arg_completers`; completer specs are those of completers.json. Flags with `value: false` are booleans. `unordered: true` compares the completion lines as a set; the directive line is always last.
